fire: In winter, tourists fly to Iceland in the hope of watching the Northern Lights.
Solar storms disturb the ionosphere and can interrupt shortwave radio.
The sounding rocket carried instruments to measure electrons in the upper atmosphere.
The aurora australis is best seen from Tasmania and southern New Zealand.
Earth's magnetosphere deflects most of the charged particles streaming from the sun.
On clear nights in Lapland the Northern Lights ripple across the whole sky.
Signals from the satellite are delayed as they pass through the ionosphere.
Curtains of the aurora borealis hung over the fjord until dawn.
